rules.name: Prior Year Promotion Cap
rules.description: Employees promoted in the prior year can qualify up to Exceeding. Cannot receive Exceptional.

rules.name: Consecutive Promotion Restriction
rules.description: Employees promoted in the prior year are excluded from promotion consideration in the current year.

rules.name: Active BOTP
rules.description: Active BOTP automatically results in Needs Improvement. Exception approval workflow allowed.

rules.name: Mandatory Training Cutoff
rules.description: If mandatory training is not successfully completed by the configured cutoff date, rating is capped at Succeeding.

rules.name: Promotion Eligibility Gate
rules.description: Promotion cases must have GetSuccess Readiness = "Ready Now" and a promotion recommendation.

rules.name: Industry Certification Requirement
rules.description: Grade C2 and above require Certification L1. Grade E and above require Certification L2.

rules.name: Longest Account Duration
rules.description: The account with the longest duration becomes the primary account for evaluation. Manual override allowed.

rules.name: Account Performance Baseline
rules.description: Account performance determines baseline rating. Practice contributions can improve rating but cannot fully override poor account performance.

rules.name: BOTP Completed
rules.description: Employees who have successfully completed BOTP can qualify up to Exceeding.

rules.name: Check-Ins Completed
rules.description: People managers should complete the configured minimum number of check-ins with each counselee (see Administration → Manager Config). Compares managerRecords.checkInsCompleted against counseleeCount × the configured minimum.

rules.name: Counselee Reviews Completed
rules.description: Tracks whether each people manager has completed a review for every one of their counselees. Applies only to people managers.

rules.name: Coaching Training Completed
rules.description: People managers should complete coaching training by the configured due date (see Administration → Manager Config). Compares managerRecords.coachingTrainingDate against that cutoff.

rules.name: 360 Survey Completed
rules.description: Tracks whether each people manager has completed their 360 survey. Applies only to people managers.

rules.name: Career Conversations Completed
rules.description: People managers should complete career conversations with each counselee by the configured due date (see Administration → Manager Config). Compares managerRecords.careerConversationDate against that cutoff.

rules.name: Account Name Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether every account on file has a name recorded.

rules.name: Primary Role on Account Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether every account has the employee's primary role on that account recorded.

rules.name: Supervisor Feedback Provided
rules.description: Tracks whether feedback from the account supervisor has been provided in GetSuccess for every account.

rules.name: 2026 Account Rating Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether every account has a current-year account performance rating recorded.

rules.name: Account Prioritization Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether every account has an A/B/C prioritization recorded.

rules.name: Account Promotion Recommendation Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether an account-level promotion recommendation has been recorded for every account.

rules.name: 2026 Revenue Managed Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether current-year revenue managed is recorded for every account.

rules.name: 2026 Sales Influenced Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether current-year sales influenced is recorded for every account.

rules.name: Account Pursuits Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether active pursuits are recorded for every account.

rules.name: Key Differentiators/Feedback Documented
rules.description: Tracks whether key differentiators or feedback are recorded for every account.

rules.name: Account Check-Ins Completed
rules.description: Account check-ins should be completed and documented. Needs configuration: where this gets documented has not been decided yet. Once decided, this can be wired to a real source instead of managerRecords.accountCheckinsCompleted, which is currently just a placeholder count.

rules.name: Mandatory Learning Completed On Time — Round Tables
rules.description: Mandatory learning tied to round tables should be completed by a set date. Needs configuration: the completion deadline for round tables has not been finalized (this is separate from the general mandatory-training cutoff in Rule R004, which already has a configured date).

rules.name: Mandatory Learning Hours Completed
rules.description: Tracks whether each employee has completed the mandatory learning hours required for their grade and country (Canada/US hours table, A through F).
